 COASTAL 
Orange Beach  
 Located on the sugar white sands 
COASTAL Orange Beach provides a waterfront restaurant, an open-air bar, and a lifestyle store all with tremendous beachfront views. Enjoy live music while taking in the views. Visit us for the ultimate dining experience!COASTAL in Orange Beach is open for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Located directly on the beach, COASTAL Restaurant provides fresh local seafood and unique culinary items from our award winning Chefs.

Video Tour 
 
 
 
 
 
 Beachfront Breakfast 
 
 Start your day with beachfront breakfast at COASTAL. 
Served daily from 8 AM, indulge in a mix of savory and sweet favorites while soaking up the beachside vibes.

 Waterfront Dining

 Beachfront Bar﻿ 
 COASTAL Beach Bar is the ultimate beachside hangout, where live music, tropical cocktails, and fresh Gulf dishes come together for the perfect experience. Whether you're here to sip, savor, or dance to the rhythm of the waves, it’s the ideal spot. 
 
 
 Style for the Shore 
 COASTAL Store has everything you need for coastal living - apparel, accessories, beach gear, and more. Shop our lifestyle boutique for the best Orange Beach experience. You can also grab a gift certificate and share the beach.

 QUESTIONS and ANSWERSWe do not take reservations or call ahead for seating as our restaurants are casual dining, first-come, first-serve. 
 
 
 
 
 
 Is COASTAL open?
 

 Yes!  COASTAL Beach Bar,  COASTAL Restaurant, and COASTAL Store are open everyday.  COASTAL Beach Bar is open 11am to close daily with a full food and drink menu. Check out our live music schedule to see who is playing on our outdoor beach stage.COASTAL Restaurant is now serving breakfast/brunch daily starting at 8am and dinner starting at 4pm.  Both settings offer a casual environment with fantastic fresh gulf seafood and the highest quality ingredients in a picturesque setting with gorgeous beachfront views and incredible sunsets. Be sure to visit COASTAL Store and shop over 3,000 square feet of beach lifestyle apparel and merchandise! The retail shop is open daily from 8am to close. 
 
 
 
 
 
 Can we make reservations?
 

 No, we are a casual "first come - first serve" restaurant. If there is a small wait you can visit the store or take in the views.
 
 
 
 
 
 How many guests at one table can you accommodate?
 

 COASTAL offers seating for a maximum of 8 people per table.  We do not offer the option of combining tables.  If you have more than 8 people, your party will be divided between numerous tables in groups of 8 or less.
 
 
 
 
 
 Do you have a private venue for weddings and receptions?
 

 We do not have any private dining space available for receptions or private gatherings.  We do not offer the option of weddings on the property.
 
 
 
 
 
 Is this where locals get dedicated beach parking?
 

 Yes, COASTAL has a dedicated parking section for Orange Beach Residents year round!
 
 
 
 
 
 Does the COASTAL Beach Bar have a happy hour?
 

 We are always happy at COASTAL. While we don't have a discounted time period, come see the views and you will see why everyone is so happy!
 
 
 
 
 
 What are your hours?
 

 COASTAL Beach Bar: 11am to closeCOASTAL Restaurant: Breakfast/Brunch - Beginning at 8amDinner: Beginning at 4pmCOASTAL Store: 8am to close
 
 
 
 
 
 Is there a fee to use a credit card?
 

 Yes, we charge a nominal surcharge for processing credit card payments. This fee is waived with all cash transactions.  There is an ATM located inside COASTAL Store
 
 
 
 
 
 Do you have vegetarian, vegan, gluten free options?
 

 Yes.  Ask your server for specific options.
 
 
 
 
 
 Do you allow dogs, cats, or any animals?
 

 No.  We allow service animals only; this includes all outdoor areas. As a reminder, petsare also not permitted on beaches in Orange Beach.
 
 
 
 
 
 Is there a charge for parking?
 

 No!  Parking is free for COASTAL customers and Orange Beach residents.
 
 
 
 
 
 Is there an age requirement?
 

 All ages are welcome at COASTAL Orange Beach. This includes COASTAL Beach Bar and COASTAL Restaurant. 
 
 
 
 
 
 Can we use your parking lot and stay at the beach all day?
 

 Parking is for COASTAL Customers and Orange Beach Residents only.  Beach access is reserved for Orange Beach Residents only.
 
 
 
 
 
 Am I required to wear shoes to dine?
 

 Shoes and cover-ups are required in our restaurant area for safety reasons. You're welcome to go barefoot at the beach bar and enjoy the sand between your toes!

mainEntity.name: Is   COASTAL   open ?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes !   COASTAL   Beach   Bar ,   COASTAL   Restaurant ,  and   COASTAL   Store   are   open   everyday .

mainEntity.name: Can   we   make   reservations ?

acceptedAnswer.text: No ,  we   are   a   casual  " first   come  -  first   serve "  restaurant .  If   there   is   a   small   wait   you   can   visit   the   store   or   take   in   the   views .

mainEntity.name: How   many   guests   at   one   table   can   you   accommodate ?

acceptedAnswer.text: COASTAL   offers   seating   for   a   maximum   of   8   people   per   table .   We   do   not   offer   the   option   of   combining   tables .   If   you   have   more   than   8   people ,  your   party   will   be   divided   between   numerous   tables   in   groups   of   8   or   less .

mainEntity.name: Do   you   have   a   private   venue   for   weddings   and   receptions ?

acceptedAnswer.text: We   do   not   have   any   private   dining   space   available   for   receptions   or   private   gatherings .   We   do   not   offer   the   option   of   weddings   on   the   property .

mainEntity.name: Is   this   where   locals   get   dedicated   beach   parking ?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes ,  COASTAL   has   a   dedicated   parking   section   for   Orange   Beach   Residents   year   round !

mainEntity.name: Does   the   COASTAL   Beach   Bar   have   a   happy   hour ?

acceptedAnswer.text: We   are   always   happy   at   COASTAL .  While   we   don ' t   have   a   discounted   time   period ,  come   see   the   views   and   you   will   see   why   everyone   is   so   happy !

mainEntity.name: What   are   your   hours ?

acceptedAnswer.text: COASTAL   Beach   Bar :  11am   to   close

mainEntity.name: Is   there   a   fee   to   use   a   credit   card ?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes ,  we   charge   a   nominal   surcharge   for   processing   credit   card   payments .  This   fee   is   waived   with   all   cash   transactions .   There   is   an   ATM   located   inside   COASTAL   Store

mainEntity.name: Do   you   have   vegetarian ,  vegan ,  gluten   free   options ?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes .   Ask   your   server   for   specific   options .

mainEntity.name: Do   you   allow   dogs ,  cats ,  or   any   animals ?

acceptedAnswer.text: No .   We   allow   service   animals   only ;  this   includes   all   outdoor   areas .  As   a   reminder ,  pets

mainEntity.name: Is   there   a   charge   for   parking ?

acceptedAnswer.text: No !   Parking   is   free   for   COASTAL   customers   and   Orange   Beach   residents .

mainEntity.name: Is   there   an   age   requirement ?

acceptedAnswer.text: All   ages   are   welcome   at   COASTAL   Orange   Beach .  This   includes   COASTAL   Beach   Bar   and   COASTAL   Restaurant .

mainEntity.name: Can   we   use   your   parking   lot   and   stay   at   the   beach   all   day ?

acceptedAnswer.text: Parking   is   for   COASTAL   Customers   and   Orange   Beach   Residents   only .   Beach   access   is   reserved   for   Orange   Beach   Residents   only .

mainEntity.name: Am   I   required   to   wear   shoes   to   dine ?

acceptedAnswer.text: Shoes   and   cover - ups   are   required   in   our   restaurant   area   for   safety   reasons .  You ' re   welcome   to   go   barefoot   at   the   beach   bar   and   enjoy   the   sand   between   your   toes !

 CONTACT US 
 
 We do not take reservations or call ahead for seating, as our restaurant is a casual dining, first-come, first-serve restaurant. 
 
 
 
 Frequent Questions 
 
 We love to hear from you, but first check out our answers to the most asked questions below. 
 
 
 
 
 
 Is COASTAL open?
 

 Yes, and features a full service bar, beach food menu, fantastic retail store and amazing waterfront views. Come visit and relax at the beachfront restaurant or bar.
 
 
 
 
 
 Can we make reservations?
 

 No, we are a casual "first come - first serve" restaurant. If there is a small wait you can visit the store or take in the views.
 
 
 
 
 
 Does the COASTAL Bar have a happy hour?
 

 We are always happy at COASTAL. While we don't have a discounted time period, come see the views and you will see why everyone is so happy!
 
 
 
 
 
 What are your hours?
 

 COASTAL Orange Beach is open daily at 8 am. The restaurant is open from 8 am for Breakfast on the Beach.  The restaurant reopens at 4 pm for dinner until 10 pm. The Beach Bar opens at 11 am each day .  COASTAL Store opens at 8 am daily. We hope to see you soon!
 
 
 
 
 
 Is this where locals get dedicated beach parking?
 

 Yes, COASTAL has a dedicated section for locals year round!
 
 
 
 
 
 Is there a fee to use a credit card?
 

 Yes, we charge a nominal surcharge for processing credit card payments. This fee iswaived with all cash transactions.
 
 
 
 
 
 Do you have vegetarian, vegan, gluten free options?
 

 Yes.  Ask your server for specific options.
 
 
 
 
 
 Do you allow dogs, cats, or fish?
 

 No.  We allow service animals only; this includes all outdoor areas. As a reminder, petsare also not permitted on beaches in Orange Beach.
 
 
 
 
 
 Is there a charge for parking?
 

 No!  Parking is free for COASTAL customers and Orange Beach residents.
